requirements.text: Declare Direct-BGP admission ceilings in the workloads Helm chart.
Declare exact Direct reasoner ceilings in the platform Helm chart.
Schema-constrain every Phase 40 Helm ceiling with closed objects and bounded numeric ranges.
Match Helm declaration defaults to the temporary 40.7/40.8/40.9 runtime hard bounds.
Declare candidate-space and partition ceilings that guarantee bounded exhaustive partition planning.
Declare bounded CPU-lane and per-lane JVM heap ceilings for exact reasoning.
Prove default exact-reasoner lane/heap consumption fits inside the reference-worker memory budget with headroom.
Declare certificate byte and proof-support ceilings.
Keep runtime ceiling consumption explicitly deferred to phases 40.11 through 40.13.
Maintain a machine-readable ceiling registry mapping Helm paths to current runtime sources and wiring milestones.
Preserve every Phase 40.9 parent payload file unless explicitly checksum-accounted.
Keep OWL Direct standards claims disabled until later qualification gates pass.
